items.title: Dalton Richards Interview, 1961-03-16
items.q: It used to be my route around, uh, Josephine Louise's house, Warren's house, and all those places.

ctx.x: They play from ten to two, and they're right on the job the next day. Well, I tell you, that's kind of tough. Yeah. And I had a whole lot of easy in the lobby was either. I'm on the parts of the post-truck, see? It used to be my route around, uh, Josephine Louise's house, Warren's house, and all those places. That was my route for about eight years, and he changed me, put me up above Calvin Edmund. Well, I admit I had it just as easy, but it was very nice on there because I could get plenty of weight musically,…
Well, I tell you, you know, I kept on playing every chance I'd get.
